hero.heading: Get Involved in Our Community
hero.subheading: Join thousands of developers, designers, and tech enthusiasts who are part of the ATech Solution community. Share knowledge, collaborate on projects, and grow together.

channels.title: Open Source

channels.title: Discord Community
channels.description: Join our active Discord server to connect with fellow developers, get help with technical challenges, and stay updated on the latest news.

channels.title: Events & Meetups
channels.description: Attend workshops, webinars, and local meetups. Learn from industry experts and network with professionals in your area.

ambassador.description: Become an official ATech Solution Ambassador and help grow our community. Share your expertise, create content, and represent our brand at events.

benefits.title: Networking
